opening.argument: The core discussion is an explanatory account of what Strategy is doing, expressly presented as a one-stop explainer for viewers examining its Bitcoin acquisition and dilution model. The investment case is qualified rather than guaranteed: buying MSTR is described as accepting counterparty risk, and the model is said to work when Bitcoin goes up and not work if Bitcoin does not. The separately identified Horizon segment is ordinary sponsored advertising promoting the use of home equity to buy Bitcoin, including claims about payments, eligibility, ownership and liquidation, alongside a QR code. But the available material does not establish deception, a required payment or data submission, or any completed transaction. The accuracy, terms, destination behavior and outcomes of those claims remain unverified.
